spec_theorems.name: foldChars_segments_length_le
spec_theorems.informal: Every segment produced by folding a line has length at most the selected width.

spec_theorems.name: foldChars_content_preserved
spec_theorems.informal: For every positive width, folding preserves the input characters in order and only inserts line breaks between segments.

spec_theorems.name: run_exit_zero
spec_theorems.informal: The modeled invocation processes standard input successfully and returns exit status 0.

spec_theorems.name: run_stdout_is_folded_stdin
spec_theorems.informal: The standard output of run is exactly the concatenation of the folded segments of each standard-input line using the selected width.
